definitions.explanation: The light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye, which turns light into nerve signals sent to the brain.

examples.japanese: {網膜|もうまく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|きず}つく→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧。
{網膜|もうまく}{剥離|はくり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had surgery for a detached retina.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}に{入|はい}った→目に入る：32672_menihairu⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{網膜|もうまく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えられ→変える：01089_kaeru⟧、⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}られる→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Light that enters the eye is turned into signals at the retina and sent to the brain.

notes:
{網|もう} (net) + {膜|まく} (membrane).

- {網膜|もうまく}{剥離|はくり}: retinal detachment
- ⟦{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}→糖尿病：04414_tounyoubyou⟧{網膜症|もうまくしょう}: diabetic retinopathy
- {網膜|もうまく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}き{付|つ}く→焼き付く：26882_yakitsuku⟧: (of a scene) to be burned into one's memory
